mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, COUNT(t.id) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN t.status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN t.status = 4 THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, t.create_time, t.finish_time) END), 2) AS avgHours FROM sys_dept d LEFT JOIN ticket t ON d.id = t.dept_id AND t.deleted = 0 WHERE d.deleted = 0 GROUP BY d.id, d.dept_name ORDER BY totalCount DESC

WITH RECURSIVE date_series AS ( SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL #{days} DAY AS dt UNION ALL SELECT dt + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM date_series WHERE dt < CURDATE() ) SELECT ds.dt AS date, COALESCE(created.cnt, 0) AS createCount, COALESCE(completed.cnt, 0) AS completeCount FROM date_series ds LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(create_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL #{days} DAY GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ) created ON ds.dt = created.d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DATE(finish_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM ticket WHERE deleted = 0 AND status = 4 AND finish_time >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL #{days} DAY GROUP BY DATE(finish_time) ) completed ON ds.dt = completed.d ORDER BY ds.dt
